goal: Integrate the BK-approved Phase 4B direct_art_v2 set into the existing Godot playable slice as one bounded playable-art pass, using one coherent Background World Layer while preserving gameplay logic, collision, movement, progression, timer, retry behavior, and QA separation.
forbidden_changes: movement, jump, gravity, timer, retry, hazard, item, or goal logic changes
collision shape or trigger behavior changes
new game mechanics or level-layout expansion
final art direction or production asset approval
stage or commit of files outside the approved art baseline and WP-040 targets

verify.name: All seven approved v2 textures are referenced
verify.command: for asset in background_world_layer_v2 player_avatar_v2 goal_marker_v2 hazard_marker_v2 collectible_item_v2 safe_platform_tile_v2 ui_status_panel_v2; do rg -q "res://assets/phase4b/direct_art_v2/${asset}.png" game/scenes/main.tscn; done

verify.name: No v1 direct art remains in the scene
Single coherent background layer is used
verify.command: test "$(rg -c 'path=\"res://assets/phase4b/direct_art_v2/background_world_layer_v2.png\"' game/scenes/main.tscn)" -eq 1 && test "$(rg -c 'name=\"BackgroundWorldLayer\"' game/scenes/main.tscn)" -eq 1 && ! rg -n "SectionOneBackdrop|SectionTwoBackdrop" game/scenes/main.tscn

verify.name: Headless scene runtime is clean
verify.command: bash -lc 'out=$(godot --headless --path game --scene res://scenes/main.tscn --quit-after 3 2>&1); printf "%s\n" "$out"; ! grep -E "SCRIPT ERROR|ERROR|Parse Error|Failed" <<< "$out"'

acceptance_criteria: The scene references all seven BK-approved direct_art_v2 PNG assets and no v1 direct-art texture.
The scene uses exactly one BackgroundWorldLayer node spanning the full playable world; it remains behind gameplay and is not interpreted as collision or gameplay props.
Player, goal, hazard, collectible, platform, and HUD use AtlasTexture crops that remove transparent source padding and preserve the intended silhouette-first hierarchy.
Existing Ground, WarmupStep, Platform, HazardArea, CollectibleArea, GoalArea, Player, Camera2D, HUD, and RetryButton nodes remain inspectable.
Collision resources and gameplay logic remain unchanged, including movement, jump, hazard fail, collectible progression, goal gating, timer, retry, and reset behavior.
Core prototype labels remain available as secondary aids rather than the primary visual distinction.
Godot import, smoke, clean headless runtime, schema, reference, no-v1, and scope checks pass or failures are recorded honestly.
A separate QA Work Package reviews the frozen implementation; implementation does not self-approve QA.
No production approval, final art direction, push, merge, or deployment occurs.
notes: BK approved all seven v2 assets for prototype integration planning on 2026-07-10. This implementation replaces only the scene's visual references and alignment. TDD is not applicable to the resource-only swap because no behavior seam is changed; deterministic runtime state-transition QA is required in the separate QA Work Package. Transition authority note: commit b33cd5a occurred after BK approval as the WP-040 implementation prerequisite that made the approved art baseline available to the playable scene. It was not a commit performed during WP-039 art-generation execution and does not weaken WP-039's prohibition on staging or committing before its owner gate.
